name: briefing_action_queue_add_set_panel_text
description: Briefing_ActionQueue::AddSetPanelText allocates a set-text action, copies the panel text, stores the target panel, hides the target, inserts the action, and returns the updated node count.
known_limits: Focused VC5 COFF byte comparison is clean in briefing_action_queue_add_methods and both covering VC5 targets; owner tier S remains deferred to the complete Briefing source-owner because tick bodies and the runtime constructor remain byte-blocked.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x404780 validates EH-framed allocation of a 0x108-byte set-text action, 0x100-byte strncpy, target storage, immediate target SetVisible(0), queue-node insertion, node-count increment, and return of the updated count.
The native briefing objective-action smoke verifies mission title, objective summary, and objective description set-text actions, target panels, copied text, and immediate hide dispatches.
